༄༅/ /tshe dpag med khro bo'i dkyil chog tshe dbang rig 'dzin nges par ster ba 'jug bde'i khrigs su sdebs pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// tshe dpag med khro bo'i dkyil chog tshe dbang rig 'dzin nges par ster ba 'jug bde'i khrigs su sdebs pa bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ bsnyen pas gnas skabs nyi zla'i tshe// mthar thug rgyal ba nyid ster ba'i// tshe dpag med pa'i zhabs btud nas// de mthu blta ba'i me long 'god/ /'dir tshe dpag tu med pa'i gsang sgrub khro bo'i dkyil 'khor sgom par 'dod pas rang don gtso bo bsnyen pa/ gzhan don gtso bo sgrub pa/ dus rgyun gyi nyams len gsum las/ dang po ni/ bkra shis pa'i gnas dbang gi las la mchog tu shis par/ yo byad tshang bar bsags te/ bde ba'i stan la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du 'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang bsgrub par bya'o snyam pas/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab sgrub pa'i// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ lan gsum gyis skyabs sems bya/ de nas/ stobs chen 'chi bdag bdud 'joms la// 'gro ba skyob mdzad rnams kyi dbus// dpa' bo chen po khyod lhag par// mthong nas dad pas spyan 'dren no// chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin// thugs rje 'gag pa med pa'i rtsal// tshe dpag med pa'i dkyil 'khor du// mngon par rol pas gshegs su gsol/ zhes dkyil 'khor 'chad par 'gyur ba lta bu mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug 'khor bcas kyi// zhabs kyi padmor phyag 'tshal lo// sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi// dge ba kun la yid dga' bas// dad pas bdag gi lus 'di 'bul// thugs rje mnga' bas ring gzigs pas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs gyur te// bdag gis byang chub mchog thob shog /badzra muḥ rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces brjod/ bshos chang ting lo gtor ma chab kyis sbran/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ a kā ro sogs kyis bgegs la bsngos la byin/ dkyil 'khor sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams nga la nyon// nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin// nga yi bka' las ma 'da' bar// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'gro bar gyis// gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na// ye shes rdo rje 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal ba brgyar 'gas shing*// lus rnams stong du gyur nas ni// rnam par 'joms par gdon mi za// de bas khyod rnams gzhan du dengs// oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya gṝ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces bskrad/ snying gar hrīḥlas me 'bar bas// rnam smin lus bsregs stong pa nyid// oṃ swa bhā wa shud dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud dho3haṃ/ don dam pa'i bsrung ba'o// zla gam smug nag dkyil 'khor du// paṃ las chu skyes 'dab ma brgyad// maṃ las nyi ma'i gdan steng du// hrīḥdamar rgyu yi sa bon las// ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// gdug pa can rnams ma lus bsregs// hrīḥlas skyes pa'i rta mchog ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar// steng zhal rta mchog ljang khu ni// drag po'i rta skad rab tu bzhad/ khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud// phyag g.yas thod dbyug dkar po bsnams// bgegs dang 'byung po ma lus 'joms// g.yon pa sdigs mdzub me ltar 'bar// gnod byed ma lus sreg par byed// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bdud bzhi mnan// spyan gsum sdang mig khro gnyer bsdus// ljags 'dril mche ba me stag 'phro// skra ser dbu rgyan thod skam can/ khrag 'dzag brgya phyed do shal byas// stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can// klu chen brgyad kyis nye bar brgyan// 'jigs byed gshin rje'i gzugs 'chang ba// gang gis mi tshugs rdo rje'i sku// de yi lto ba yangs pa'i nang*// e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ bhruṃ// zhu ba chos 'byung rlung me chu// sa dang lhun po gzhal yas khang*// gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs can// sngo ser dkar ljang dmar ba'i rtsig /'dod snam pha gu dra ba dang*// shar bu mda' yab rgyan gyis spras/ khang brtsegs dbus 'phyur rin chen tog /padma rdo rje me ris bskor// nang khyams shar sngo lho ser nub// dkar dang byang ljang grwa nang dmar// lte bar padma 'dab ma brgyad// dbus su padma tshe dpag med// shar du rdo rje tshe dpag med// lho ru rin chen tshe dpag med// nub tu rnam snang tshe dpag med// byang du las kyi tshe dpag med// gtso bo lnga ka li khri'i mdog

/cung zad khro la 'dzum ba'i nyams// sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// bum par bcas pa'i thod pa 'dzin// rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs pa'o// de dag pang du yum chen lnga// bcu drug lon pa sku sha rgyas// 'jam zhing nu ma 'bur ba la// padma rdo rje rin chen dang*// 'khor lo sna tshogs rdo rje ste// g.yas pa rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin// g.yon pa thod pa bdud rtsi bkang*// yab la stob cing sku la 'khril// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pas// snyoms 'jug zag med bde ba rgyas// mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi'i bum pa bzhi// nang gi lha yi snam bu la// shar me rdo rje khro bo dang*// lho srin rin chen khro bo dang*// nub rlung padma'i khro bo dang*// byang dbang 'phrin las khro bo dang*// steng 'og rnam snang khro bo gnyis// rang 'dra'i yum dang bcas pa ni// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bzhengs pa'o// mdog dmar g.yas par rang rtags 'dzin// g.yon pa tshe yi bum pa ste// sbrul dang rin chen sna tshogs brgyan// me ri 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs// phyi grwar bdug spos mar me ma// me tog ma dang dri chab ma// sgo bzhir rdo rje lcags kyu dag /zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma// bzhengs pa khro bo'i tshul du gnas// g.yas pa rang ming g.yon tshe bum// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan// de nas spyan 'dren pa ni/ stobs chen 'chi bdag bdud 'joms la// 'gro ba skyob mdzad rnams kyi dbus// dpa' bo chen po khyod lhag par// mthong nas dad pas spyan 'dren no// chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin// thugs rje 'gag pa med pa'i rtsal// tshe dpag med pa'i dkyil 'khor du// mngon par rol pas gshegs su gsol// zhes spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang snying ga'i 'od zer gyis// dbang lha bde gshegs rigs lnga ni// yum bcas spyan drangs sbyor ba mdzad// byang chub sems kyis dbang bskur nas// rang rigs rnams kyi bdag por zhugs/

de nas mchod pa ni/ tsan dan dmar po'i chu'i mchod yon/ rgya skyegs kyi chu'i zhabs bsil/ me tog dmar po'i rigs/ si hā la sogs spos/ mdangs dmar por bsgyur ba'i mar me/ pad rag gi yon chab/ 'byung ba rtsi khrag byugs pa'i zhal zas/ snyan pa'i rol mo rnams/ dbang du byed pa'i la du/ 'dod pa lnga/ bdud rtsi/ sha lnga/ rjes chags de bzhin nyid de// dbang gi mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sbyangs rtogs sbar nas/ 'dod dgu'i tshogs thams cad du snang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin chen por gyur par bsams te/ hūm̐/ kun tu bzang pos rgyal ba mchod pa'i tshe// ji ltar sprul rnams sku gsung thugs dang ni// ye shes rdo rje gsang ba las 'thon pa'i// 'dod dgu'i sprin gyis bcom ldan 'khor bcas mchod// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos sgron// dri chab zhal zas rol mo 'dod yon lnga// bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lnga re re yang*// kun nas dgyes dgu kun tu sprul pas mchod// bzhin mdzes me tog dri zhim bdug pa'i spos// chags pa'i sgron ma drod kyis rngul ba'i chab// ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi ngoms med bde ba'i ro// 'dod pa'i snying por rjes su chags pas mchod// ma rig gis rmongs 'khor bar rengs pa'i 'gro// sdig pas myos par gyur pa'i ma rungs pa// snying rjes khros pas chos dbyings bsgral ba'i baṃ// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi/ zhes mchod/ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ 'chi med dbang po'i rgyan gos kyis spras pa// 'gro la rjes chags 'dod chags chen po'i gzugs// nyi ma 'char ka'i mdangs su lham me ba'i// mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// na rga 'chi ba'i gdung ba rnams 'joms shing*// yid 'ong 'dod pa'i lang tsho gang byed pa// ye shes bdud rtsi'i snod 'dzin mnyam gzhag can// mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// pad nyi'i dbus na klu dbang gnyid pa ltar// rdo rje skyil krung mdzad pa'i pang na yum// bde ba'i mchod sbyin ci yang bgyid pa can// mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// gdul bya rnam mang 'dul tshul tha dad dgongs// sna tshogs rigs kyi rol gar la zhugs pa'i// khro chags lha yi snang ba mi zad pa'i// dkyil 'khor ba la rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo// tshe dang bsod nams ye shes rgyas pa'i byin// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la zhugs pas// rgyal ba nyid kyi sku gsung thugs grub pa'i// dngos grub dam pa tshe 'dir stsal du gsol//

de nas lha tshogs rnams kyi snying gar tshe'i bum pa de'i nang du sa bon sngags kyis bskor bar bsams te/ oṃ hrīḥhūm̐ swā oṃ āḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a pa ri mi ta a yurdzñā na mahā siddhi ha sa ni ri ti swā hā/ zhes spyi dril gyi sngags bzlas/ de'i dus sngags phreng las tshe bsring dpal bskyed pa'i dam tshig gi bdud rtsi babs/ bum pa gang bar gyur/ zhes brjod/ bdag bskyed rkyang pa'i skabs tshe 'gugs bya zhing bstim/ gtor ma 'bul/ bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal bsdus la dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis bya'o// gnyis pa gzhan don gtso bo sgrub pa ni/ sa phyogs bkra shis par bgegs la gtor ma btang*/ bka' bsgo bskrad/ bsrung 'khor gnyis bsgom te/ dkyil 'khor thig tshon rigs lnga'i sa bon bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ thig gdab tshon bkye/ yang na 'bru'i tshom bu bkod/ steng du mañdzi'i khar las bum/ gtso bo'i bum pa bzang po bum rdzas dang ldan pa'i chus sum gnyis gang ba mgul dkris rigs kyi phyag mtshan gyis mdzes pa/ de'i steng du ka pā la mtshan ldan/ tshe rdzas kyi chang bzang pos bkang ba/ de'i kha gcod kyi tshul du tshe'i 'brang rgyas dkar gsum mngar gsum/ 'bru dkar po'i phye la sbrus pa la dbyibs zar ma'i bum pa lta bu la/ rtse la rdo rje rtse lnga nyi zla nor bus spras pa/ 'og tu padma 'dab bzhi rigs bzhi'i phyag mtshan/ rmang du zhi rgyas dbang drag gi mtshan ma zlum po gru bzhi zla gam gru gsum/ mtshams su rdo rje rgya gram/ bar du bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad kyis mdzes pa dang*/ mda' rgod sgro ma/ bar du oṃ ā hūm̐ bhrūṃ hrī hūm̐ swā oṃ a/ oṃ bhrūṃ a sa ni ri ti che ge mo la tshe dang longs spyod dbang thang spel du gsol bris pa dar dmar me long btags pa dang*/ tshe nas la bkra shis rtags brgyad bkod pa mdun/ tshe ril g.yas/ bsrung ba'am bsrung mdud g.yon/ tshe zas kyi snod rgyab/

gzhan mda' dar rnam lnga/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ de nas bdag bskyed kyi bzlas pa grub mtshams/ las thams cad par dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ las bum mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ zla gam smug nag dkyil 'khor du// paṃ las chu skyes 'dab ma brgyad// maṃ las nyi ma'i gdan steng du// hrīḥdamar rgyu yi sa bon las// ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// gdug pa can rnams ma lus bsregs// hrīḥlas skyes pa'i rta mchog ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar// steng zhal rta mchog ljang khu ni// drag po'i rta skad rab tu bzhad/ khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud// phyag g.yas thod dbyug dkar po bsnams// bgegs dang 'byung po ma lus 'joms// g.yon pa sdigs mdzub me ltar 'bar// gnod byed ma lus sreg par byed// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bdud bzhi mnan// spyan gsum sdang mig khro gnyer bsdus// ljags 'dril mche ba me stag 'phro// skra ser dbu rgyan thod skam can/ khrag 'dzag brgya phyed do shal byas// stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can// klu chen brgyad kyis nye bar brgyan// 'jigs byed gshin rje'i gzugs 'chang ba// gang gis mi tshugs rdo rje'i sku/ zhes pa'i bar dam ye dbyer med du bskyed/ thugs kar nyi ma la hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar dmigs te/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya gṝ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ snying gar sngags 'phreng rta sngags bzla/ sku las bdud rtsi bab pa bum pa'i bdud rtsir gyur/ yang na 'od zhu bya/ de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bum pa mdun gyi dkyil 'khor/ bum pa/ thod pa/ tshe gtor/ tshe mda' tshe ril rnams las sngags kyis bsangs/ swā bhā wa sa sbyangs la/ mdun bskyed ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ tshe rten dam tshig gi rdzas rnams mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/

pa tshe 'dir stsal du gsol/

ces bstod/ de nas mdun bskyed bskul ba'i sngags bzla ba ni/ bdag nyid kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs brgyud bskul/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sgrub bya'i tshe nyams pa bkug /'byung ba bzhi'i bcud/ sems can gyi tshe dang bsod nams/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bsdus nas thugs ka'i tshe bum gyi nang du thim pas 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang bar dmigs te/ oṃ hrīḥhūm̐ swa oṃ āḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.a pa ra mi ta a yurdzñā na ma hā siddhi ha sa ni ri ti swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla bar bya'o// de nas tshe 'gugs pa ni/ dgung gnyis nang nub thun bzhir tshe 'gugs rgyas par bu mo gtsang ma lnga'am gcig mda' dar g.yob/ spos btang rol mo bya/ dbyangs snyan pa gyer bzhin pas/ hrīḥ phyogs bzhi'i sgo ma drag shul chen mo'i 'phrul// sa dang sa 'og nam mkha'i khams gang bas// bdag gi tshe 'phrog brku ba'i phyogs skyong gdon// lcags kyus snying bzung zhags pas mgrin pa chings// lcags sgrog gis sdom dril bus mnyed mdzod la// lag gi tshe srog phrogs la 'dir khug cig /zhes bskul bas rang 'dra ba'i sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bkye nas phyogs skyong bcu'i gdon tshe dpal 'byor pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rnams kyi snying lcags kyus phug /mgrin pa zhags pas bcings/ yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams/ dril bus lus mnyes te lag gis bdag gzhan gyi tshe phrogs pa de slar bsdus par bsam/ yang*/ hrīḥ phyogs bcu'i khro rgyal drag shul chen po'i 'phrul/ sa dang sa 'og nam mkha'i khams gang bas// bdag gi tshe srog brku ba'i gdon bgegs dang*// 'chi bdag bdud sde rnams kyi mgo 'khos la// de dag snying nang gnas pa'i tshe srog dang*// 'jig rten khams kyi 'byung bzhi'i bcud bsdus shig /zhes bskul bas khro rgyal yab yum rnams kyi sprul pas gdon bgegs bar du gcod byed thams cad bsgral// de dag gi snying ga'i tshe/

'jig rten khams kyi 'byung ba bzhi'i bcud thams cad drangs nas bum pa'i bdud rtsi la bstim/ yang*/ hrīḥdabang drag padma rigs kyi dkyil 'khor nas// khrag 'thung bde gshegs rigs lnga yab yum rnams// thugs rje dgongs la dbyings nas sku bzhengs te// sprul pa yang sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pas// srid gsum zil mnan khams gsum dbang bsdus te// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi ye shes dang*// rig 'dzin rnams kyis rtse gcig bsgrubs pa'i tshe// 'jig rten bsod nams las thob srog khug cig /ces bskul bas/ gtso bo yab yum rnams kyi sprul pa sna tshogs pas sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi tshe'i gzungs/ rig 'dzin grub pa rnams kyis rtse gcig bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ 'jig rten las kyi tshe srog dwangs ma 'chi med kyi bdud rtsir bgrang ba thams cad bum nang du ye shes kyi bdud rtsir spyan drangs dam tshig tu gnas pa dang ro gcig tu gyur ba 'phel zhing lud pas lus thams cad mer gyis gang bar bsams te/ oṃ hrīḥhūm̐ swa oṃ āḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.a pa ra mi ta a yurdzñā na ma hā siddhi ha sa ni ri ti swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥbhrūṃ ratna siddhi ā yu pu ṇya bhrūṃ bhrūṃ/ zhes pa nyer gcig sogs kyis gtor ma byin brlab bya/ oṃ hrīḥhūm̐ swa oṃ āḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.a pa ra mi ta a yurdzñā na ma hā siddhi ha sa ni ri ti swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ratna siddhi ā yu pu ṇya ka pā la siddhi bhrūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes nyer gcig sogs kyis thod rdzas byin brlab bya/ oṃ hrīḥhūm̐ swa oṃ āḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.a pa ra mi ta a yurdzñā na ma hā siddhi ha sa ni ri ti swā hā/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ shu ti bha li bhe te pa ra ma siddhi swā hā/ zhes pa nyer gcig sogs kyis tshe ril byin brlab bya/ oṃ hrīḥhūm̐ swa oṃ āḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.a pa ra mi ta a yurdzñā na ma hā siddhi ha sa ni ri ti swā hā/

zhes pa nyer gcig sogs kyis tshe mda' byin brlab bya/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya gṝ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa nyer gcig sogs kyis srung skud byin brlab bya'o// bum chu dang bdud rtsi khol zhing lud pa dang gtor ma bkrag mdangs rgyas pa'i bdud rtsir zhu ba'am 'dzag pa la sogs pa'i rtags thon nas tshe dbang bskur/ bdag nyid kyi don du yin na dbang len pa'i tshul dang mthar dngos grub len/ tshogs kyi sgo nas longs spyod pa rnams bya ste/ de la slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i rim pa ji lta bas bdag nyid 'jug par bya ba ste/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus byas/ bshos chang ting lo dang bcas pa'i bgegs gtor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ dkyil 'khor sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams nga la nyon// nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin// nga yi bka' las ma 'da' bar// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'gro bar gyis// gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na// ye shes rdo rje 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal ba brgyar 'gas shing*// lus rnams stong du gyur nas ni// rnam par 'joms par gdon mi za// de bas khyod rnams gzhan du dengs// oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya gṝ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bskrad/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba zlum po la rdo rje'i mda'i drwa bas brgyan pa/ bar mtshams med pa/ cis kyang mi tshugs pa/ cis kyang mi shigs pa/ cis kyang mi 'jigs pa'i rdo rje'i mkhar me'i phung po 'bar ba nam mkha'i khams khyab pa zhig tu gyur/ ces srung 'khor bsgom mo/ de nas/ oṃ badzra bhū mi ā hūm̐ sogs nas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo mi tha dad pa'i drung du dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du

sogs kyis maṇḍal phul/ bla ma gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i spyan sngar/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces lan gsum gyis skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed/ de nas/ bcom ldan mgon po byams ldan tshe dpag med// thugs kyi dkyil 'khor rin chen bum nang gi /byang chub sems kyi ā yu ṣe dmar po// rtse gcig bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i tshe lags na// byin gyis rlobs la myur du stsal du gsol/ zhes khyad par gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas las sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ rang nyid kyi phung po khams dang skye mched rnams mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ padma'i sdong po 'dab ma 'bum ldan par// tshe dpag med pa li khri'i mdog /cung zad khro la 'dzum pa'i nyams// sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// bum par bcas pa'i thod pa 'dzin// rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs pa'o// de yi pang du rgyal ba'i yum// bcu drug lon pa sku sha rgyas// 'jam zhing nu ma 'bur ba la// phyag g.yas rang rtags padmo 'dzin// g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis bkang*// yab la stob cing sku la 'khril// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pas// snyoms 'jug zag med bde ba rgyas// bde ba can nas ye shes pa kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar// byon nas rang la thim par bsgom/ byas la spos kyis bdug /bla mas rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// tshe dang longs spyod gter gyi bdag /mthu chen ji snyed bzhugs pa rnams// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin gyis rlobs// mthu chen rnams kyis mthu stsol zhig /dbang chen rnams kyis dbang bskur zhig

/byin chen rnams kyis byin phob cig /'chi med bdud rtsi'i char phab cig /tshe dpal longs spyod kun stsol zhig /badzra ā yu ṣe ā be sha ya aḥ.aḥ zhes pa byin phab 'jug pa'o// de nas tshe rdzas rnams la tshe 'gugs bya ba ste/ hrīḥ phyogs bzhi'i sgo ma drag shul chen mo'i 'phrul// sa dang sa 'og nam mkha'i khams gang bas// bdag gi tshe 'phrog brku ba'i phyogs skyong gdon// lcags kyus snying bzung zhags pas mgrin pa chings// lcags sgrog gis sdom dril bus mnyed mdzod la// lag gi tshe srog phrogs la 'dir khug cig /zhes bskul bas rang 'dra ba'i sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bkye nas phyogs skyong bcu'i gdon tshe dpal 'byor pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rnams kyi snying lcags kyus phug /mgrin pa zhags pas bcings/ yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams/ dril bus lus mnyes te lag gi bdag gzhan gyi tshe phrogs pa de slar bsdus par bsam/ yang*/ hrīḥ phyogs bcu'i khro rgyal drag shul chen po'i 'phrul/ sa dang sa 'og nam mkha'i khams gang bas// bdag gi tshe srog brku ba'i gdon bgegs dang*// 'chi bdag bdud sde rnams kyi mgo 'khos la// de dag snying nang gnas pa'i tshe srog dang*// 'jig rten khams kyi 'byung bzhi'i bcud bsdus shig /zhes bskul bas khro rgyal yab yum rnams kyi sprul pas gdon bgegs bar du gcod byed thams cad bsgral// de dag gi snying ga'i tshe/ 'jig rten khams kyi 'byung ba bzhi'i bcud thams cad drangs nas bum pa'i bdud rtsi la bstim/ yang*/ hrīḥdabang drag padma rigs kyi dkyil 'khor nas// khrag 'thung bde gshegs rigs lnga yab yum rnams// thugs rje dgongs la dbyings nas sku bzhengs te// sprul pa yang sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pas// srid gsum zil mnan khams gsum dbang bsdus te// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi ye shes dang*// rig 'dzin rnams kyis rtse gcig bsgrubs pa'i tshe// 'jig rten bsod nams las thob srog khug cig

/zhes bskul bas/ gtso bo yab yum rnams kyi sprul pa sna tshogs pas sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi tshe'i gzungs/ rig 'dzin grub pa rnams kyis rtse gcig bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ 'jig rten las kyi tshe srog dwangs ma 'chi med kyi bdud rtsir bgrang ba thams cad bum nang du ye shes kyi bdud rtsir spyan drangs dam tshig tu gnas pa dang ro gcig tu gyur ba 'phel zhing lud pas lus thams cad mer gyis gang bar bsams/ de nas tshe'i 'brang rgyas spyi bor bkod nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i nang nas sku'i lha tshogs rnams bzhengs nas spyi bor byon te dbang bskur bar bsam/ oṃ/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku yi gsang ba gsum las byung*// khams gsum kun gyi tshe 'dus pas// sku yi dbang bskur thob par shog /ces dbang bskur bas gtor ma'i tshe dpag med kyi lha tshogs rnams spyi bo'i gtsug nas rim gyis thim/ snying kar bdud rtsir zhu ba lus thams cad khyab pas tha mal pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad dwangs ma 'ja' tshon gyi ngo bo skye 'jig gzhom gzhig thams cad dang bral ba tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku rdo rjer gyur/ de nas thod pa spyi bor bzhag la dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i nang nas gsung gi lha tshogs rnams bzhengs nas bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur bar bsam/ bdud rtsi lce thog sbyin/ āḥ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gsung gi gsang ba gsum las byung*// khams gsum kun gyi tshe 'dus pas// gsung gi dbang bskur thob par shog /de ltar dbang bskur bas thod pa'i lha tshogs rnams slob ma'i ngag la thim pas ngag sngags kyi ngo bo skye 'jig gzhom gzhig thams cad dang bral ba tshe dpag med pa'i gsung rdo rjer gyur/ bum pa thogs nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha yi nang nas thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams bzhengs nas bum pa'i dbang bskur bar bsam/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing bum chu blud nas/

hūm̐/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs kyi gsang ba gsum las byung*// khams gsum kun gyi tshe 'dus pa// thugs kyi dbang mchog thob par shog /de ltar dbang bskur bas bum pa'i lha rnams chur zhu bas spyi bo nas zhugs/ ma rig pa'i dri ma thams cad bkrus pas rig pa ye shes kyi ngo bo skye 'jig gzhom gzhig thams cad dang bral ba tshe dpag med pa'i thugs rdo rjer gyur/

de nas tshe mda' g.yas tshe zas g.yon du gtad de/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i nang nas yon tan gyi lha tshogs rnams bzhengs te dbang bskur bar bsam/ swā/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// bral dang rnam smin las byung ba// khams gsum kun gyi tshe 'dus pa'i// yon tan dbang mchog thob par shog /de ltar dbang bskur bas tshe mda'i tshe dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs 'od kyi rnam par lus ngag yid la thim pas ma rig pa'i gnyid sad/ shes bya thams cad la blo rgyas pa'i ngo bo skye 'jig gzhom gzhig thams cad dang bral ba tshe dpag tu med pa'i yon tan thob par bsam/ de nas tshe ril khar sbyin tshe nas lag tu gtad de/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i nang nas phrin las kyi lha tshogs rnams bzhengs te dbang bskur bar mos/ hā/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gzhan don mdzad pa las byung ba// khams gsum kun gyi tshe 'dus pa// 'phrin las dbang mchog thob gyur cig /de ltar dbang bskur bas tshe ril gyi lha tshogs bdud rtsir zhu ba myang bas 'chi med thob pa tshe nas kyi lha bkra shis pa'i g.yang du gyur pa gzhan gyi don la gcig tu brtson pa skye 'jig gzhom gzhig thams cad dang bral ba tshe dpag tu med pa'i 'phrin las par gyur pa'o// de nas slob ma'am rang gi lus de yongs su gyur pa'i gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa shin tu che zhing sra ba cis kyang mi shigs pa/ cis kyang mi chod pa/ cis kyang 'joms par mi nus pa/ brtan pa/ sra ba/ mkhregs pa/ nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang mnyam pa zhig tu gyur/ hūm̐/ bskyed pas mi nub tshe yi rang bzhin ni// spros pas khams gsum thams cad bkrag dang ldan// bsdus pas srid pa gsum po'i gzi mdangs 'phrog /bcings pas 'du 'bral med de lu gu brgyud// brtan pas mi g.yo ri rab lhun po ltar// rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub thob par shog ces spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying ga gsum du rdo rjes rgyas gdab/

tshig re lan gsum du brjod par bya'o// srung ba'am srung mdud ske'am dpung par btags shing*/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya gṝ wa hu lu hu luhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas nas de la rgyas gdab/ de nas me tog thogs/ oṃ/ yon tan rgyas pas sku mdog gser dang mtshungs// shes rab chen po'i rtags su ral gri bsnams// 'phags pa 'jam dpal bkra shis gang yin pa'i// bkra shis dam pa deng 'dir bde legs shog spyi bor 'thor/ thugs rjes bsil mdzad sku mdog zla nya 'dra// skyon gyis ma gos phyag na padma bsnams// spyan ras gzigs kyi= bkra shis= mgrin par 'thor/ 'gyur ba med pa sku mdog mthing nag ste// mthu stobs cher ston phyag na rdo rje bsnams// gsang ba'i bdag po'i= bkra shis= zhes snying gar me tog dor ro/ de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad pa'i drung du dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i sku drin gtang rag gi yon du/ zhing khams rgya mtsho rdul rer rdul snyed kyi/ sogs nas/ chos kyi rgyal po mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /gu ru i daṃ maṇḍal la sogs gtang rag gi maṇḍal 'bul bar bya'o/ de nas tshogs kyi rim pa ni/ tshogs rdzas la las chu 'thor zhing*/ bdud rtsis bran te lag pa g.yas pa bkab/ oṃ ma dag pa sbyangs/ lag pa g.yon pa bkab/ āḥmang por spel/ gnyis ka bkab/ hūm̐ bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga'i rang bzhin du sbar/ nam mkha' lding gi phyag rgya bstan/ hoḥ ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bzhu bar bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ zhes lan gsum du brjod/ spyan 'dren zhing byin dbab pa ni/ gtan gyi skyabs mgon bla ma rin po che// dag pa'i zhing mchog gang na bzhugs lags kyang*// dad pa'i shugs kyis gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no// thugs rje'i gter chen myur du 'byon du gsol// dam rdzas 'di rnams ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur// bdag cag rnams la byin brlab dbang bskur nas// 'bral ba med par rjes su gzung mdzad pas// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// bdag gis rtse gcig bsgrubs pa'i yi dam lha// dag pa'i zhing mchog=

dad pas shugs kyis= thugs rje'i gter chen= dam rdzas 'di rnams= bdag cag rnams la= 'bral ba med par= 'chi med tshe yi= dam tshig can gyi stangs 'dzin mkha' 'gro ma// dag pa'i zhing mchog= dad pas shugs kyis= thugs rje'i gter chen= dam rdzas 'di rnams= bdag cag rnams la= 'bral ba med par= 'chi med tshe yi= kun tu bsrung skyob byed pa'i chos skyong tshogs// dag pa'i zhing mchog= dad pas shugs kyis= thugs rje'i gter chen= dam rdzas 'di rnams= bdag cag rnams la= 'bral ba med par= 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ ces byin dbab byas/ tshogs phud dang po/ dang por phud kyis mchod pa ni// byin gyis rlob pa'i bla ma dang*// dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha// bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro ma// phrin las bsgrub pa'i chos skyong la// dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas ma lus pa// nam mkha' gang bar dmigs te 'bul/ bar pa ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong thams cad rang sems su// gcig pa sngon chad ma 'tshal ba// bdag gis nyes pa chen po byas// da ni so so rang rig pa'i// ye shes klong du mthol lags na// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag bzhin// dbyer med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// mtha' ma ni/ bdag gi tshe 'phrog gdon gyi tshogs// 'chi bdag bdud kyi sder bcas rnams// tshogs 'dir bstim nas khyed zhal bstabs// rtag tu bgegs dang bral bar shog ces gtor ma phul/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥsbyangs rtogs sbar bdud rtsir bzhu bar gyur/ stobs chen 'chi bdag bdud 'joms la// 'gro ba skyob mdzad rnams kyi dbus// dpa' bo chen po khyod lhag par// mthong nas dad pas spyan 'dren no// chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin// thugs rje 'gag pa med pa'i rtsal// tshe dpag med pa'i dkyil 'khor du// mngon par rol pas gshegs su gsol/ 'jig rten las 'das pa la 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad kyi bskor te nam mkhar byon par

bsam/ oṃ hrīḥhūm̐ swa oṃ āḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.a pa ra mi ta a yurdzñā na ma hā siddhi ha sa ni ri ti i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'jig rten las 'das pa la phul/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs lan gsum gyis 'jig rten pa rnams la bsngo/ nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya che kun 'grub cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol te gatstshā mi zhes pas gtor mgron ye shes pa rnams rang la thim/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas so sor gshegs par gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon sogs la las kyi rdo rjes me tog la sogs pas mchod nas/ bsod nams 'di yis sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes thob gyur cig ces pas btung ba nas rim bzhin 'bul/ lha dang rang gi sbyin sreg gis tshim par rol/ rdo rje'i glu sogs len/ lhag ma kha phru btab ste/ lhag la dgyes pa'i ma dang sring*// 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul can// dkar ser dmar ljang sngo dang khra// dgyes par 'di la rol nas kyang*// zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las// gang la gang 'os mdzad pa na// bsam pa lhun gyis grub pa yis// dngos grub myur du thob par gsol// oṃ utstshiṣṭa ba lingta bhakṣa bhyaḥswā hā/ lhag ma phyir dor ro/ tshe dpag med pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ sogs smon lam btab/ rjes kyi mchod pa gtang rag mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ kun tu bzang pos rgyal ba mchod pa'i tshe// ji ltar sprul rnams sku gsung thugs dang ni// ye shes rdo rje'i gsang ba las thon pa'i// 'dod rgu'i sprin gyis bcom ldan 'khor bcas mchod/ zhes pas mchod/ hrīḥ 'chi med dbang po'i rgyan gos gyis spras pa// 'gro la rjes chags 'dod chags chen po'i gzugs// nyi ma 'char kha'i mdangs su lham me bas// mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod// gdul bya rnam mang 'dul tshul tha dad dgongs// sna tshogs rigs kyi rol gar la zhugs pa'i// khro chags snang ba mi zad pa'i// dkyil 'khor pa la rtag tu phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/

de nas dngos grub bskul ba ni/ tshe rdzas thogs te dkyil 'khor la skor ba byed cing*/ tshe dpag med pas byin rlabs dngos grub rdzas// tshe yi 'brang rgyas ri rab lhun po 'dra// tshe chang thod pa zag med bdud rtsi'i mtshor// tshe bum bkra shis gser 'gyur rtsi lta bu// srog mda' mi g.yo ril bu bsam 'phel rdzas// dang po phud kyis brgyud pa'i bla ma mchod// dgyes par rol la thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs// gnyis pa yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// gnyis med rol la rigs lnga'i dngos grub stsol// gsum pa ma mgon dam can rgya mtsho mchod// g.yar dam skongs la thogs med 'phrin las sgrubs// de rnams mnyes pa'i lhag mas mched lcam mchod// dngos grub kun 'dus 'dod pa'i re ba gang*// gnas skabs mthar thug gnyis ka'i tshe stsol zhig /gter bdag chen po nor gyi dngos grub stsol// bu slob dar zhing rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// ci bsam lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol/ zhes tshe'i 'brang rgyas las rdo rje nyi zla nor bu blangs te/ oṃ hrīḥhūm̐ swa oṃ āḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.a pa ra mi ta a yurdzñā na ma hā siddhi ha sa ni ri ti swā hā/ zhes snying po'i sngags kyis mgor byug /oṃ bla ma sku'i rgya/ āḥyi dam gsung gi rgya/ hūm̐ mkha' 'gro thugs kyi rgya/ ho dam can yon tan 'phrin las kyi rgya rim pa bzhin btab pas tshe mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur gyur cig /tshe mi 'gyur ba g.yu drung lta bur gyur cig /tshe mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bur gyur te/ nyi zla dang tshe mnyam pa'i dngos grub thob par gyur cig ces tshe rdzas la longs spyod/ yig brgya brjod cing lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ sogs kyis nongs bshags dang bzod gsol bya/ mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams bdud rtsi bde ba'i ngo bor zhu nas rten dang bdag la thim par

bsam la/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ sogs kyis brtan bzhugs bya ba'am/ yang na bdag bskyed la bstim pas kyang 'thus/ de nas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i bdag bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams bdag nyid la thim zhing*/ de yang mi dmigs pa 'od gsal gyi ngang la bzhag te/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med pa 'grub gyur nas/ sogs kyis dge rtsa byang chub mchog tu bsngo bas rgyas gdab/ rdul tshon yin na a kā ro sa bsdus te bum par spyan drangs te chu la gshegs dge ba bsngo shis brjod sogs bya'o// gsum pa ni/ rgyun tu nyams su len pa la/ tho rangs khwa ta'i skad mi sgrag gong du/ bde ba'i stan la kha bde ba can phyogs la gtad/ skyabs sems byas/ sems can gyi don du 'chi med sgrub par 'dod pa'i blos/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa nyid/ de'i ngang las/ padma'i sdong po 'dab ma 'bum ldan par/ tshe dpag med pa li khri'i mdog nas/ de yi pang du rgyal ba'i yum// bcu drug lon pa sku sha rgyas// 'jam zhing nu ma 'bur ba la// phyag g.yas rang rtags padmo 'dzin// g.yon pa man nas/ bde ba rgyas zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin/ de nas oṃ ā yu ṣe sa ra ha ka ra ṇe sha ra re swā hā/ ces gsol ba btab/ sngar bzhin gyi mchod bstod bya/ de'i bum nang du sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wān tī ye swā hā/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ de las bdud rtsi babs bum pa khengs sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ tshe gdon bgegs kyi phrogs pa/ 'byung bzhi'i bcud sems can dang rig 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi tshe bsdus/ de la thim pas 'phel zhing khol lud de bum pa'i kha nas zham zham byung*/ rang gi spyi bo'i bu ga nas zhugs pas lus thams cad dmar ltem ltem mas rim gyis gang bas/ rang skad cig gis tshe dpag med kyi skur gyur/ mdun bskyed bdag la ye shes pa'i tshul du thim par

bsam ste/ oṃ ye dharma sogs brtan par bya ba'i sngags brgya rtsa las mi nyung bar bzla/ thun bshol ba ni/ mthar lus gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa gang gis kyang mi chod pa zhig tu gyur par bsam ste/ dge ba bsngo// rigs gsum gyi shis pa brjod par bya'o// tshe dpag med zhi ba la mos na de'i mngon rtogs dang mchod bstod tsam bya/ gzhan gcig go /de ltar tshe dpag tu med pa khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga tshe dbang rig 'dzin nges par ster ba zhes bya ba/ grub pa'i rgyal mo'i gzhung de nyid kyi zur skol gyi man ngag nas cung zad kha bskang ba sngags grwa slob dpon ngag dbang kun dga' snying po'i ngor padma dkar pos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gro mo ba blo gros rnam rgyal gyis bgyis pa'o// slad nas sgrub mchod dang dbang bskur sogs la 'jug pa bde ba'i ched 'don 'grigs rgyun chag nar 'gros su ngag dbang mthu stobs tshul khrims bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos bkod pa'i dge bas 'gro rnams 'chi med rtag pa dam pa'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga laṃ/// /bkra shis//
